matching_unit: Same state, normalized action radius and sign; require all four direction actions feasible as in original complete-cell comparison. Evaluate each direction against both random controls; no selection using object outcomes.
amplitude_rule: Absolute pair difference divided by max(pair values, numericfloor)<=caliper, for realized EEF translation RMS/max and fullSO3angular RMS/max separately. Numeric floors translation1e-7m androtation1e-5rad; zero-motion cases retained/labeled, not counted as informative motion.
frequency_rule: Totalvariation<=caliper between normalized DCT-II power in [0,2.5),[2.5,5),[5,10),[10,infinity)Hz for worldXYZ displacement plus yaw_length_scale times fullrotationvector relative to nominal; includes DC and suffix, same500Hz window. This is coarse frequency matching, not equal full spectra.
informative_motion: Either member translationRMS>1e-5m or rotationRMS>1e-4rad, reported separately without removing from primary support.
weighting: Average matched candidate-pair outcomes within state, then equal state weighting with initialfamily bootstrap. State/family support and unmatched counts byphase reported for every caliper, including zero support.
scope: Post-hoc exploratory matching on realized robot response (a post-intervention variable), not causal identification of WM object information or deployable predictor. No fulltrajectory equality, no test matching/tuning, no claim compute matched. Predeclare all calipers and report all rather than selecting a favorable result. Existing audited physical bank reused; no new executions.
